title: As AI salaries intensify competition in San Francisco's rental market, CoStar says average asking rent is up 18% in under two years to $3,728/month, passing NYC (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: As AI salaries intensify competition in San Francisco's rental market, CoStar says average asking rent is up 18% in under two years to $3,728/month, passing NYC — Lack of housing supply is colliding with sky-high AI salaries: 'OK, we'll pay $10,000' — SAN FRANCISCO—Flowers and wine for listing agents at open houses.
